name: The Heritage Balnarring
signature: Balnarring's village pub, in a 1930s heritage home on a two-acre block, with open fires, a sunny deck and a large beer garden.
editorNote:
The Heritage is the pub in the middle of Balnarring village: a 1930s heritage home on a two-acre block, with its original open fires inside, a sunny deck, and a large beer garden with a grass area and sandpit where children can play. The owner-operators have set out to make it a place for entertaining again, and the format suits an intimate dinner as readily as a large family table.

The kitchen runs two lists. A pub favourites menu covers the classics, from a chicken parma or schnitzel to pub-style fish and chips, and a specials board changes with what has come in. Through winter there is a Sunday roast, served until it sells out. Live music plays on the deck most Sunday afternoons, and a private dining room takes functions from April to September.

It opens Wednesday to Sunday from 11:30am and is closed Monday and Tuesday. Call to book a table. Pets are not allowed in the venue, so this is not the stop for a dog day.
whyWeGo: A village pub with room to move: open fires for winter, a deck and a big beer garden for the warmer months, and a kitchen that keeps the pub classics alongside a changing specials board.
ifOnlyOneThing: Go on a winter Sunday for the roast by the fire, and book ahead, because it is served until it sells out.

closureNote: Resolved 2026-09-13, not a closure. This record was filed as The Balnarring Pub at 3050 Frankston-Flinders Rd with the domain balnarringhotel.com.au, which does not resolve (NXDOMAIN against 1.1.1.1), and no business has been found trading under that name. The pub in Balnarring village is The Heritage Balnarring at 3059 Frankston-Flinders Rd, and the record's own description (village pub, open fires, beer garden, Sunday roast) matches it, so the record was corrected to that business rather than retired. Checked against the operator site: About (https://www.theheritagebalnarring.com.au/about) for the 1930s home, two-acre block, fires, deck, beer garden, sandpit, Sunday music and the no-pets rule; Visit (https://www.theheritagebalnarring.com.au/visit) for address, phone 03 5983 2597 and Wednesday to Sunday hours; Menu (https://www.theheritagebalnarring.com.au/eat) for the pub favourites and winter Sunday roast; Functions (https://www.theheritagebalnarring.com.au/functions), sitemap lastmod 2026-09-05.
